profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. According to its website, the company supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, which it says are intended to advance innovation across the semiconductor industry. The site also describes how the company's business model is meant to accelerate innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and it notes TSMC's contribution to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, traded under the ticker TSM, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001046179. It also appears in records under the alias TAIWAN SEMICONDUCTOR-SP ADR. No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
